subject: Clarion: pause on inference pilot while we re-prioritize
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@clarityhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Clarion pilot: ask to shift timing due to roadmap + travel

Hey Neha / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the demo with Aditya was really helpful. I wanted to flag that our product org just pushed a hard decision: we have to reallocate engineering capacity to a cross-functional analytics migration that starts next sprint. That means we need to pause new pilots that touch inference until leadership completes the migration planning (likely 6–10 weeks).

Also, two of our core stakeholders (including myself) will be on a 10-day field visit Oct 11–20 which makes scheduling anything substantive awkward.

Can we put our Clarion inference pilot on hold for now and revisit in early December? Procurement asked that we avoid signing anything until the roadmap clears. Apologies — we still think Redwood is a strong fit, this is an internal timing shift.

If helpful, happy to share the migration timeline and who will own re-evaluating the pilot when we return.

Samantha Li
Director, Product Operations
ClarityHealth

Attachment: Clarity_roadmap_high_level.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion pilot: ask to shift timing due to roadmap + travel

Samantha —

Totally understand, and thanks for the heads up. Appreciate the transparency about the analytics migration and the travel window. We can absolutely pause and hold the materials until you’re back in December.

Quick questions so we can make the pause clean:
- Would you like us to freeze the SOW draft as-is, or withdraw it so Procurement isn’t chasing?
- Do you want a brief one-page recap of what we accomplished in the discovery/demos to put into your backlog?
- Who should we circle back to in early December (you or a delegated stakeholder)?

We’ll archive the sandbox access and stop scheduled runs to avoid incurring cost on your side. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute re-intro for the week of Dec 6 to pick things up quickly.

Aditya / Rishi — tagging you to confirm we’ll put infra sandbox into pause mode and flag the HubSpot deal as "nurture – paused".

Thanks, and enjoy the field trip.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samantha Li <samantha@clarityhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion pilot: ask to shift timing due to roadmap + travel

On Fri, Oct 1, 2027 at 11:04 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Samantha —
> 
> Totally understand, and thanks for the heads up....

Thanks Neha — to your questions:
- Procurement asked we hold off on the SOW for now; please do not send updated agreement versions until we confirm.
- A one-page recap would be perfect to drop into the backlog and share with the migration leads. Could you include the expected resource needs and a short note on latency/unit cost expectations?
- I will be the primary contact for now. If that changes I’ll introduce the delegate before Dec.

We’ll plan to re-evaluate after leadership’s Q4 planning meeting — likely early December. If anything changes sooner we’ll reach out.

Appreciate you being flexible.

Samantha

Attachment: procurement_hold_notice.txt (plain text)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 22:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion pilot: ask to shift timing due to roadmap + travel

Samantha — thanks for confirming. We’ll take the following actions immediately:

1) Archive the SOW draft and mark the HubSpot deal CLAR-2027-003 as "paused — customer reprioritized". (Aditya, please confirm when done.)
2) Pause the sandbox and stop scheduled inference runs to avoid charges.
3) Prepare a one-page recap that includes what we delivered in discovery, estimated GPU / cost profile for the pilot, and a recommended warm-start checklist for reactivation.

I attached the two documents we mentioned for your backlog: 
- Clarify: short tech stack matrix for the pilot;
- SOW (archived copy) — we will not send any new contracts while you’re on hold.

We’ll reach out the week of Dec 6 to propose two windows for a 30-minute re-intro. If you end up delegating, feel free to introduce the new contact to me directly.

Safe travels and good luck with the migration work.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ClarityHealth_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 290KB); tech_stack_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
